design: Retrospective case illustration selected after viewing previous cohort cases; not representative or independent confirmation.
eligibility: Both labels; >=20 total channels; no minimum EZ count. Exclude all three previously selected patients. Require DRE three-seed mean AUROC and Recall10 positive, >=2 seeds jointly improve AUROC and Recall10. Require mean TP increase and >=2 seeds increase TP; mean precision must not decline.
fp_tiers: All three DRE seeds FP increase <=0
All three DRE seeds FP increase <=2 channels
selection: Use first nonempty tier; maximize mean DRE TP increase, then minimize mean FP change, then maximize equal-weight mean delta AUROC/delta Recall10, then fixed identifier SHA256. Never adjust frozen original validation thresholds.
report: All original five endpoints, all four confusion counts, precision, sensitivity, FPR and predicted positive counts for SVM and each DRE seed plus endpoint means. Retain every seed and negative result.
privacy: CASE-F01/CH aliases only outside trusted server; identity and original names private.
